info.title: Unify Sequences API
info.summary: Interact with sequences and sequence enrollments within the Unify platform.

post.description:
Start an asynchronous query job that exports sequence enrollment steps —
per-person executions of each sequence step, including sent email
engagement and any reply. Omitting `filter` exports all enrollment
steps. Poll the job until it is `FINISHED`, then page through the
results.

post.description:
Enroll a person in a sequence. `mailbox_emails` lists candidate sending
mailboxes, one of which is selected at enrollment time. If the person is
already actively enrolled in a sequence, the request fails with a `409`
identifying the active enrollment.

get.description:
List sequence enrollments — each tracks one person's progress through a
sequence along with reply, bounce, opt-out, and pause state. Pages at
most 100 enrollments per request; to export more than a few hundred
enrollments, create an asynchronous query job instead.
